description: Tag selection component displaying selected tags as colored chips with a dropdown for adding more. Supports inline search with filtering, optional inline tag creation via OnCreateTag callback, and disabled state. Its popup is a TmOverlayPanel with ConstrainHeight: the list is capped at the room left on the resolved side (and at its own CSS max-height), and the cap follows the room in both directions — it regrows as room returns while the panel is open.

parameters.name: OnTagsChanged
parameters.description: Fires when the selection changes, passing the updated list.

parameters.name: AllowCreate
parameters.description: When true, shows an option to create a new tag inline.

parameters.name: OnCreateTag
parameters.description: Fires when the user requests creation of a new tag, passing the tag name.

parameters.name: Class
parameters.description: Additional CSS class for the root element.

interfaces.name: ITag
interfaces.description: Minimal tag UI contract. Use shared TmTag or TmTagRef when you do not need a custom domain tag class.

members.name: Id
members.description: Unique identifier used to compare tags and avoid duplicates.

members.name: Name
members.description: Display name shown in the chip and dropdown option.

members.name: Color
members.description: CSS color value for the tag badge, e.g. "#3b82f6" or "var(--tm-color-primary)".

examples.title: Tag picker with inline creation — complete page example
examples.description: Full example using shared TmTag state and OnCreateTag handler that creates and immediately selects the new tag.
